response_excerpt.summary:
The analysis joined traffic and orders tables by product_id and date, then summarized by traffic channel. Results show:
- **ads**: 700,850 page views, 420,576 unique visitors, 1,000 paid orders, ¥969,918.75 revenue, conversion rate 0.2378%
- **social**: 701,470 page views, 413,926 unique visitors, 955 paid orders, ¥817,103.75 revenue, conversion rate 0.2307%
- **referral**: 701,830 page views, 421,141 unique visitors, 1,000 paid orders, ¥783,216.25 revenue, conversion rate 0.2375%
- **organic**: 700,230 page views, 413,192 unique visitors, 955 paid orders, ¥632,519.75 revenue, conversion rate 0.2311%

The ads channel generates the highest revenue and order count, while organic traffic has the lowest revenue. Conversion rates are very consistent across channels (~0.23-0.24%).
